clusters.title: Mistral AI Launches Leanstral 1.5, Solving 587 PutnamBench Problems
clusters.summary: Mistral AI has released Leanstral 1.5, a free Apache-2.0 code agent model designed for Lean 4. This model successfully solves 587 out of 672 problems from the PutnamBench benchmark. It features a 119 billion parameter mixture-of-experts architecture that activates 6.5 billion parameters per token, showcasing its capabilities in real bug-finding case studies and deployment.

This investment is part of a broader strategy to solidify South Korea's leadership in the global AI chip market.
